profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer | TypeScript, Node.js, Python, SQL, NoSQL, Svelte, React
profile.summary:
I am a full-stack software engineer specializing in building interactive video platforms, scalable cloud applications, and data-driven user experiences. With expertise in technologies such as Svelte, TypeScript, React, Node.js, Python, SQL, Firebase, Elasticsearch, and Google Cloud, I create robust end-to-end solutions that bring engaging, media-rich applications to life.

My work has spanned projects for leading global media clients like Netflix, Disney, Hulu, and Amazon, where I’ve developed features that enhance audience engagement, streamline video workflows, and deliver real-time analytics at scale. From architecting cloud-native backends to designing intuitive interfaces, I thrive on solving complex technical challenges with elegant, high-performance solutions.

Passionate about innovation, usability, and impact, I continuously expand my skill set to stay ahead of evolving technologies. I enjoy collaborating with forward-thinking teams to build transformative products that connect people, spark engagement, and push the boundaries of what’s possible in media technology.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Led full lifecycle delivery of “ad pod” playback features, designing seamless transitions where parent video pauses, interactive pods play in sequence, and primary content resumes, unlocking future monetization and engagement opportunities.

• Designed a Netflix-style channel browsing experience where users could scroll through multiple interactive videos, preview content on hover, and select videos that appealed most to them, powering survey workflows that gathered rich, actionable engagement data for clients.

• Refactored video view and live viewer counting system by migrating logic from exposed Admin API endpoints into a serverless architecture with Firestore triggers, scheduled Cloud Functions, and Pub/Sub events, improving scalability, eliminating client-side dependency, and reducing security surface area.

• Shipped production-ready features across Svelte/TypeScript front-end and GCP/Firebase back-end, consistently delivering end-to-end solutions directly impacting client engagement strategies.

• Delivered multilingual AI-powered video conversation features by implementing translation pipelines and Elasticsearch indexing, enabling global users to interact with content in their native language and expanding the company’s client base into international markets.
positions.insights: Skills: Full-Stack Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) · Svelte · Firebase · Cloud Firestore · Elasticsearch · Node.js · Google Cloud Platform (GCP) · Terraform · Artificial Intelligence (AI) · Playwright · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD)

positions.title: Senior Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Led a team of 4 engineers in successfully deploying projects, overseeing
project planning, coordination, and execution.

- Designed and implemented scalable cloud solutions using Microsoft
Azure, including virtual machines, Azure Functions, and SQL Database,
resulting in a 40% improvement in system performance and a 20%
reduction in operational costs.

- Developed a Node.js server to seamlessly migrate functionality from a
Workato cloud platform to an Azure-based Node.js server, improving
system scalability and reducing company expenses by 35%.

- Contributed to the successful migration of Java-based software from an
acquired company, ensuring seamless integration and minimal disruption
to ongoing operations.

- Maintained and enhanced legacy codebases written in Java and PHP,
implementing optimizations and updates to improve performance,
stability, and maintainability.

positions.title: Open Source Developer
positions.description:
- Created Node.js/Express server to efficiently handle HTTP requests to a myriad of endpoints based on the middleware design pattern.

- Developed RESTful API using Node.js and Express.js that connected to a MongoDB Database to Store and retrieve user data.

- Utilized Mongoose to model application data and implement data validation.

- Implemented the container pattern in React and created reusable components to easily maintain and uniformize the codebase.

- Utilized Redux to effectively manage the application state allowing us to store state in a centralized location where it is immutable and can only be modified through the dispatch of actions allowing for optimal efficiency by not storing the same information in multiple locations.

positions.title: Full Stack Software Engineer
positions.description:
● Directed and spearheaded the successful development initiative of corporate-scale microservices using React, React-Router, and
Typescript, effectively facilitating seamless and efficient communication of tasks within the organization
● Implemented robust security measures to safeguard company information and research data within the microservices, ensuring
compliance with industry standards and regulations while bolstering the company's cybersecurity posture
● Played a pivotal role in enhancing backend development efficiency by meticulously defining SQL schemas for projects, providing
clear guidelines for data structure, and actively collaborating with teammates to optimize performance and scalability
● Developed cross-platform mobile applications using Ionic, ensuring seamless user experiences across iOS and Android platforms
● Implemented Redux to manage application state efficiently, enhancing scalability and maintainability of the software system
● Successfully delivered responsive and user-friendly interfaces that significantly improved the user experience for the internal
team members, thereby contributing to a more streamlined workflow and enhancing overall productivity

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Migrated Svelvet to a novel architecture to enhance performance and establish the codebase such that future teams can scale and iterate efficiently by modularizing the codebase and converting it to an Object-Oriented Programming style
- Modularized components to isolate issues and enable future developers to easily debug and add features
- Refactored the Svelte store to develop a non-persistent, relational database that utilizes a randomized ID to allow components to reference each other to ensure its product with 4000 weekly npm downloads runs effortlessly
- Enhanced long-term maintainability and reduced runtime errors by using Typescript to implement type notation
- Utilized Jest Testing Library to validate that the application behaves as expected by testing each of its components
- Utilized TypeDoc to generate well-structured documentation detailing engineering decisions and improving consistency
